questions.prompt: Which process produces the most variation?
Use a Punnett square to show that a couple has a 50% chance of having a girl each time.
questions.modelAnswer: The mother (XX) can only give X eggs. The father (XY) makes sperm that carry X or Y in equal numbers. The Punnett square gives XX, XX, XY, XY: 2 in 4, so 50% girls (XX) and 50% boys (XY). Each fertilisation is independent, so the chance is 50% every time, whatever earlier children were.
